statement.zh: 历史与语文学综合将米坦尼表述为晚青铜时代上美索不达米亚—北叙利亚的胡里安主导王国，其政治史主要依据赫梯条约与阿马尔那书信等文本重建（Wilhelm 1989；Bryce 2005）。
statement.en: Historical and philological syntheses frame Mitanni as a Late Bronze Age Hurrian-led kingdom of Upper Mesopotamia–northern Syria, reconstructed largely from Hittite treaties and Amarna correspondence (Wilhelm 1989; Bryce 2005).
